<header class="dg-head dg-head-chapter"><p class="dg-kicker">Chapter 5</p><h1 class="dg-title">Fields</h1></header>
<div class="dg-motivation"><div class="dg-motivation-title">Motivation: From a vector at a point to a vector at every point</div><div class="dg-motivation-upper"><p>The tangent space <span class="math inline">\(T_p\mathcal{M}\)</span> lives at a single point, whereas quantities such as a velocity field or the metric vary from point to point. Assigning a vector <span class="math inline">\(\mathcal{X}_p \in T_p\mathcal{M}\)</span> to every <span class="math inline">\(p \in \mathcal{M}\)</span>, smoothly, requires a single smooth manifold containing all tangent spaces. Their plain union is not one, since it identifies their zero vectors, all equal to the map <span class="math inline">\(f \mapsto 0\)</span>, and carries no charts.</p>
</div><div class="dg-motivation-lower">
<p><strong>Goal.</strong> Make “a smooth assignment of a tensor to every point” precise.</p>
<ul class="dg-itemize dg-depth-1">
<li><p>Glue the tangent spaces into the <strong>tangent bundle</strong> <span class="math inline">\(T\mathcal{M}\)</span>, a <span class="math inline">\(2d\)</span>-dimensional smooth manifold that keeps track of the base point of each vector through a projection <span class="math inline">\(\pi : T\mathcal{M} \to \mathcal{M}\)</span>.</p></li>
<li><p>Define a <strong>vector field</strong> as a smooth section of <span class="math inline">\(T\mathcal{M}\)</span>, covector fields likewise through the cotangent bundle, and tensor fields as <span class="math inline">\(C^\infty(\mathcal{M})\)</span>-multilinear maps.</p></li>
<li><p>Since the numbers that rescale fields become scalar fields, fields form <span class="math inline">\(C^\infty(\mathcal{M})\)</span>-modules rather than vector spaces, and bases of fields exist in general only locally.</p></li>
</ul>
<p>The rest of the notes is formulated with fields. The connection differentiates them, the metric is a tensor field, and the Einstein equations relate tensor fields.</p></div></div>
